summary.reference: Original Ultra 1536x1536 input at the same held-out frame IDs and crop angles; High renders linearly upsampled to 1536.
summary.masks: Intersection of both runs' masks; same valid pixels for both scores; views with <1% valid pixels excluded.
summary.limitation: Each model uses its own estimated poses. Profile, sampling, splat budget and mapping method differ; this compares outputs without isolating their causal effects. Masked PSNR does not measure removal of people or novel-view geometry.
